objective: Fix shared plugin synchronization so obsolete agents-shared plugin cache versions are reliably removed from every managed Profile, and verify managed Profile deletion removes only its owned Home.

acceptanceCriteria.description: After synchronization, each shared plugin cache contains only the currently selected version.
The selected plugin version and its contents remain intact when obsolete versions are removed.
Deleting a managed Profile removes its tool-owned Home directory without deleting unrelated directories.
Automated regression tests reproduce stale plugin-version residue and verify managed Profile directory deletion.
Rust tests, frontend build, formatting check, and Rust check pass after the change.

constraints: Preserve unrelated uncommitted changes and existing Profile data outside plugins/cache/agents-shared.
Only remove obsolete version directories for plugins present in the shared marketplace.
Profile deletion may remove only the exact managed Home owned by the deleted Profile.

reasons: The fix and verification cover deletion inside tool-owned managed Profile directories.

escalateWhen: The fix requires deleting data outside an exact managed Profile Home or changing plugin enablement semantics.
requiredApprovals: Delete obsolete agents-shared plugin version cache directories during explicit synchronization.
Delete the exact tool-owned Home when the user explicitly deletes its managed Profile.
